name: E2E: Requestor resolves issue through knowledge article without ticket creation
objective: Validate the complete end-to-end journey where a user logs in, opens the AI Assistant, asks a question, receives a knowledge article answer, confirms resolution, and no ticket is created (ticket deflection).
precondition: User has valid credentials. Knowledge articles exist in the system matching the user's question.

steps.description: Log in to the self-service portal with valid credentials
steps.expectedResult: User is authenticated and redirected to the home page

steps.description: Verify the Agentforce icon is displayed on the home page
steps.expectedResult: Agentforce icon is visible on the home page
AI Assistant panel opens with greeting and capability explanation

steps.description: Verify user identity is automatically recognized
steps.expectedResult: The assistant addresses the user by name

steps.description: Describe the issue in natural language
steps.testData: "How do I connect to the corporate VPN from home"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant identifies intent as a VPN connectivity question

steps.description: Verify a relevant knowledge article is retrieved and displayed
steps.expectedResult: Knowledge article answer is displayed with source reference

steps.description: Confirm that the article resolved the issue

steps.expectedResult: No incident number or ticket link is shown

steps.description: Verify the interaction is logged as a ticket deflection
steps.expectedResult: The session is recorded as a knowledge deflection

steps.description: Verify the assistant offers further assistance
steps.expectedResult: The assistant asks if the user needs help with anything else
